items.heading: A Sales to Marketing Career
items.text: A sales to marketing career switch in India shows up constantly because the two functions sit next to each other on the org chart, and because sales burns people out faster than most desk jobs. Quota pressure, month-end pipeline stress, and constant travel or client-facing hours push a real share of sales professionals to look sideways rather than out of the company entirely.

items.heading: Do Not Walk Into This
items.text: Do not walk into this switch thinking you are starting from zero. A serious sales background already builds three things marketing job descriptions explicitly ask for, and most career-changers coming from other fields have to build these from scratch.

items.heading: Sales Persuasion Happens Live, Adjusted
items.text: Sales persuasion happens live, adjusted in real time to one person's reaction. Marketing content has to land cold, in writing, for a stranger who will never talk to you.

items.heading: This Means Practising Structured Writing
items.text: This means practising structured writing: a one-pager, a case study, a short campaign email, written to be understood in one read with no follow-up question allowed.
